item.title: Where to find the Netshin Tech Complex in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: The Netshin Tech Complex in DMZ in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is one of the most fortified areas in the game, and for good reason. It contains plenty of high-tier loot, will usually have a lieutenant inside, often has commanders in the general vicinity, and you'll even need to go here for missions at one point.

item.title: Sony Doubles Down on Officially Ditching Physical Media
item.description: It seems that Sony wants nothing to do with physical media. Just a few months after announcing the end of physical disc production for games on PlayStation consoles, the electronics giant is reportedly winding down a key part of its dedicated high-end Blu-ray player business.

item.title: Prime Video's New Fallout TV Series Sets 2027 Release Date
item.description: Prime Video's Fallout is a runaway success for Amazon, with the first season racking up over 100 million views. The TV show's initial run was also a critical hit, garnering 17 Emmy nominations, including Outstanding Drama Series and Outstanding Lead Actor in a Drama Series for The Ghoul actor Walton Goggins. The second season generally received positive reviews, and anticipation is high for the currently in-production third season of Fallout .

item.title: The best traits in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: The best Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ traits will seriously elevate your operator into a beast in Hajin, because there are some ridiculously overpowered options available. However, it's worth noting that only six traits per skill tree are fixed, indicated by the bigger symbols, so we'll call them major traits. For every operator, the rest of the smaller traits (minor) are in a random order, although they are locked to their respective tree.

item.title: Marvel's Mystery Spy Series Gets First Details, Official Writing Team
item.description: At New York Comic Con earlier this month, Marvel Studios announced that its next live-action television show would be Zodiac . While it was described as a spy thriller, few details were shared about who or what the show will focus on. We are finally getting some clarity as it appears Marvel has found Zodiac ’s writing team.

item.title: 15 Years Later, Ned Stark's Greatest Game of Thrones's Line Is Still the Boldest Quote in Fantasy History
item.description: One reason Game of Thrones enthralled viewers the moment it debuted on HBO in 2011 was that, as much as its large main cast was full of cutthroat bastards (both metaphorical and literal), every character had tremendous depth that made you understand who they were. This understanding came from what they did and said, and almost everyone in the sprawling cast has at least one poetic quote that defines their character.

item.title: Beloved Game Studio’s Fate Looks Grim after Xbox Abandons It
item.description: In July, Microsoft announced a "reset" for Xbox , a euphemism for the over 3,000 layoffs it plans to make at Xbox between July 2026 and 2027. Those layoffs included a couple studios being forced to go independent , but the fate of others was unclear. Microsoft told Dishonored and Marvel's Blade developer Arkane Studios' management on July 16 that it intended to close the studio. But because Arkane is based in Lyon, France, Xbox has had to adhere to French labor laws and therefore could not close Arkane right away.

item.title: Plan to Save BioWare and Mass Effect Proposed by Canadian Politician
item.description: The game industry is still reeling from the announcement that EA and its new private equity investors shut down the legendary BioWare . The studio was one of the medium's most renowned developers, known for Mass Effect , Dragon Age, Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic , Jade Empire , and more. Shortly after the news came out, a former BioWare developer reportedly leaked a trailer for the unreleased Mass Effect Universe , which rubbed salt in the wound.

item.title: Ridley Scott's Long-Awaited 148-Minute Action Epic Scores Big on Netflix
item.description: Ridley Scott takes his sweet time when delivering on sequels. The acclaimed director, whose original post-apocalyptic thriller The Dog Stars comes to streaming this month , took 33 years before returning to the Alien franchise (for better or worse) with 2012's Prometheus . He turned around a sequel relatively quickly with 2017's Alien: Covenant . Before any of that, Scott directed a sequel to another filmmaker's work, releasing The Silence of the Lambs follow-up Hannibal in 2001.
